statement: The function returns a result r such that: (1) for every index j with 0 <= j < len(r), the integer r[j] occurs in at least two of the three arrays nums1, nums2, nums3; (2) for every integer v, if v occurs in at least two of the three arrays, then there exists an index j with 0 <= j < len(r) and r[j] = v; and (3) for every i, j with 0 <= i < j < len(r), r[i] != r[j].
preconditions: The lengths of nums1, nums2, and nums3 are each between 1 and 100 inclusive, and every element of nums1, nums2, and nums3 is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

statement: The function returns a result r (it does not fail, panic, or overflow) for every input satisfying the preconditions.
preconditions: The lengths of nums1, nums2, and nums3 are each between 1 and 100 inclusive, and every element of nums1, nums2, and nums3 is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, for every index j with 0 <= j < len(r), the integer r[j] occurs in at least two of the three arrays nums1, nums2, nums3.
preconditions: The lengths of nums1, nums2, and nums3 are each between 1 and 100 inclusive, and every element of nums1, nums2, and nums3 is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, for every integer v, if v occurs in at least two of the three arrays nums1, nums2, nums3, then there exists an index j with 0 <= j < len(r) and r[j] = v.
preconditions: The lengths of nums1, nums2, and nums3 are each between 1 and 100 inclusive, and every element of nums1, nums2, and nums3 is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, for every i, j with 0 <= i < j < len(r), r[i] != r[j].
preconditions: The lengths of nums1, nums2, and nums3 are each between 1 and 100 inclusive, and every element of nums1, nums2, and nums3 is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, len(r) <= 100.
preconditions: The lengths of nums1, nums2, and nums3 are each between 1 and 100 inclusive, and every element of nums1, nums2, and nums3 is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, for every index j with 0 <= j < len(r), 1 <= r[j] <= 100.
preconditions: The lengths of nums1, nums2, and nums3 are each between 1 and 100 inclusive, and every element of nums1, nums2, and nums3 is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, len(r) equals the number of distinct integers v such that v occurs in at least two of the three arrays nums1, nums2, nums3.
preconditions: The lengths of nums1, nums2, and nums3 are each between 1 and 100 inclusive, and every element of nums1, nums2, and nums3 is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, if no integer v occurs in at least two of the three arrays nums1, nums2, nums3, then len(r) = 0.
preconditions: The lengths of nums1, nums2, and nums3 are each between 1 and 100 inclusive, and every element of nums1, nums2, and nums3 is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, if nums1, nums2, and nums3 are all equal as lists (they have the same length and for every index i in that length, nums1[i] = nums2[i] = nums3[i]), then for every integer v, v occurs in r if and only if v occurs in nums1.
preconditions: The lengths of nums1, nums2, and nums3 are each between 1 and 100 inclusive, and every element of nums1, nums2, and nums3 is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, if nums1 and nums2 are equal as lists and no value occurs in both nums3 and nums1 (i.e., the sets of values occurring in nums3 and nums1 are disjoint), then for every integer v, v occurs in r if and only if v occurs in nums1.
preconditions: The lengths of nums1, nums2, and nums3 are each between 1 and 100 inclusive, and every element of nums1, nums2, and nums3 is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r for the inputs (nums1, nums2, nums3), for every reordering (p1, p2, p3) of the three slices (nums1, nums2, nums3), the function returns a result r' for the inputs (p1, p2, p3) such that the set of elements of r' equals the set of elements of r. That is, the set of values in the result is invariant under any reordering of the three input arrays.
preconditions: The lengths of nums1, nums2, and nums3 are each between 1 and 100 inclusive, and every element of nums1, nums2, and nums3 is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, if no value occurs in both nums1 and nums2 (i.e., the sets of values occurring in nums1 and nums2 are disjoint), then for every integer v, v occurs in r if and only if (v occurs in nums1 and v occurs in nums3) or (v occurs in nums2 and v occurs in nums3).
preconditions: The lengths of nums1, nums2, and nums3 are each between 1 and 100 inclusive, and every element of nums1, nums2, and nums3 is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, if every value that occurs in nums3 also occurs in nums1 (i.e., the set of values occurring in nums3 is a subset of the set of values occurring in nums1), then for every integer v, v occurs in r if and only if v occurs in nums3 or (v occurs in nums1 and v occurs in nums2).
preconditions: The lengths of nums1, nums2, and nums3 are each between 1 and 100 inclusive, and every element of nums1, nums2, and nums3 is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r for (nums1, nums2, nums3) and a result r' for (nums1', nums2', nums3'), where for each i the set of values occurring in numsi' equals the set of values occurring in numsi (i.e. numsi' is obtained from numsi by reordering and/or adding or removing repetitions of values), the set of elements of r equals the set of elements of r'.
preconditions: The lengths of nums1, nums2, and nums3 are each between 1 and 100 inclusive, and every element of nums1, nums2, and nums3 is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, for every integer v, v occurs in r if and only if (v occurs in nums1 and v occurs in nums2) or (v occurs in nums1 and v occurs in nums3) or (v occurs in nums2 and v occurs in nums3).
preconditions: The lengths of nums1, nums2, and nums3 are each between 1 and 100 inclusive, and every element of nums1, nums2, and nums3 is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r for (nums1, nums2, nums3) and a result r' for (nums1', nums2', nums3'), if every value occurring in nums1 occurs in nums1', every value occurring in nums2 occurs in nums2', and every value occurring in nums3 occurs in nums3', then every value occurring in r also occurs in r'.
preconditions: The lengths of nums1, nums2, and nums3 are each between 1 and 100 inclusive, and every element of nums1, nums2, and nums3 is between 1 and 100 inclusive (likewise for nums1', nums2', nums3').
